verdict.rationale: Crossmint's evidence is entirely about REST/API integration for developers and agent-to-merchant/payment flows (e.g., agent cards, wallets, x402/MPP quickstarts) and about feeding its docs into AI coding assistants like Cursor/Copilot for faster integration — none of this describes an end-user natural-language command interface for operating Crossmint itself. There is no chat/NL interface, skill, or MCP-style command layer through which a user issues natural-language instructions to drive wallet or checkout actions.
